# Heading {{< meta version >}} and {{< meta count >}}

Version via inline cell: `{lmd} meta.version`

Count via inline cell: `{lmd} meta.count`

Flag via inline cell: `{lmd} meta.flag`

Workaround: `{lmd} tostring(meta.version)`

Literal number: `{lmd} 42`

Arithmetic: `{lmd} meta.count * 2`

In a list with a string: `{lmd} {"v", meta.version}`
